dedupe_keys.name: a database of shear wave velocity profiles from the united states

description: A Database of Shear Wave Velocity Profiles from the United States is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Morgan Sanger, University of Washington-Tacoma Campus (uw.edu). This dataset contains 539 shear wave velocity (Vs) profiles from across the United States. The Vs data herein were processed and standardized according to the procedure described in the README file, which also includes formatting and structure details. The data are provided in both Python and Matlab file formats. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 4 top-level files (PDF, MAT, PKL). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-phsq-wv17. Keywords:  subsurface characterization,  geotechnical data, shear wave velocity. Published 2025-10-31. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
